result_text:
I fixed the typos in the default conventions in `ScopingConventions.java`. The scoping tests in `codeanalyzer` (`*Scoping*`) pass. I didn't add new tests, so the `.htm`, `<doc>` XML and `*-gradle.js` cases aren't covered by a test.

- **HTML rules:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules now match `html|htm|xhtml` instead of the duplicated `html|html|xhtml`, so `.htm` pages land in the generated scope.
- **`.xml` and `.js` generated rules:** the `.NET` `<doc>` rule and the `// Generated by …` JavaScript rule used `.*/[.]xml` and `.*/[.]js`. They are now `.*[.]xml` and `.*[.]js`, so real files like `MyAssembly.xml` and `app.js` can match.
- **Gradle rule:** the build-and-deployment rule used `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js`. It is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

The new patterns are strictly broader than the old ones, so everything that matched before still matches. The `.xml` and `.js` rules still need the `<doc>` or `// Generated by` content line, so ordinary hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files stay out of the generated scope.
